title: Bear trophy
content:
# Bear trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyBjorn | Source: Bear | Usage: Building, Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Bear trophy is a rare drop from Bears in the Black Forest.

### Building

• Bearskin rug

### Crafting

• Headdress of the Bear
• Bronze Pendant

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can NOT be used to program the Ballista, as of version 0.221.4...

## Notes

• Considering that bears are pretty rare and hard to find, and since the trophy has only a 10% chance of spawning, if you are unlucky you may have to kill dozens of bears to get a single trophy.

Categorias: Trophies
